statement: Phase 1 of solve-v2 (weight): the pre-solve-v2 tag marks the last pre-refactor head, every tarball and every file over 1 MB under solve/ is uploaded to the solve-evidence GitHub pre-release with a verified sha256 and recorded on its quest, none remains tracked, the pre-commit binary guard refuses any new one, generated files are no longer committed, the runbook documents partial clones, and the history purge is documented as deferred.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Gate: no tarball tracked under solve/, no file over 1 MB under solve/ except the one allowlisted text log, the pre-commit binary guard in place; the 20 MB target belongs to phase 2.
No git history is rewritten; the purge stays documented as deferred (design note section 5).
Every evidence record is written only after the asset was downloaded again and re-hashed to the local file.
